title: AI Workflow Automation
subtitle: Find a paid SMB wedge before the demo becomes a commodity.
description: Start with $500, no customers, and a credible technical demo. Discover a painful workflow, reach the real buyer, and prove repeatable value before inference cost, privacy concerns, and founder overload consume the runway.
learningObjectives: Separate demo appeal from paid evidence
Manage company and personal runway independently
Use a concierge wedge before automating

problems.title: The ICP is still a collection of guesses
problems.summary: Demo interest is not evidence of a frequent, expensive workflow problem.
hypotheses: Operations teams lose hours to manual handoffs
The buyer primarily wants compliance evidence
The pain is curiosity rather than urgency

problems.title: There is no credible path to the buyer
problems.summary: Cold outreach is reaching users, but not the person who controls budget and risk.
hypotheses: A practitioner can become a champion
The target segment is too broad

problems.title: Personal runway can end before company cash
problems.summary: The founder needs an income path without turning the startup into unbounded custom work.
hypotheses: A scoped diagnostic service can fund discovery
Living costs can be reduced safely
Part-time work is the least harmful bridge

problems.title: The product scope exceeds the evidence
problems.summary: Platform ambitions are creating rework before a narrow outcome has been validated.
hypotheses: One integration is the real product
The core value is the decision, not the automation
